protocol.amendment_before_results: Eastmoney disconnected persistently. Tencent fallback provides OHLCV only. Test five observed channels; do not fabricate turnover amount. Six-channel draft retained separately.
protocol.data_quality: Preserve source values. Flag OHLC violations exceeding 0.011 index point; exclude every target input/label window containing an invalid bar. Exclude P0 candidate segments crossing invalid source bars; do not delete calendar rows or impute values.
protocol.prototype_algorithm: DTW farthest-point initialization then 3 partition/medoid iterations, at most 48 candidates per cluster
protocol.dtw_local_cost: absolute difference of per-segment z-scored log-close
protocol.dtw_normalized_cost: minimum cumulative path cost divided by the length of that same path; not minimum-average-cost DTW
protocol.remainder: preserve leading residual shorter than minimum_length as a separate patch
protocol.feature: 5 OHLCV channels log-transformed and standardized within each observed 125-day window; each patch resampled to 5 points; append duration, end position, valid mask; right align at most 25 patches
protocol.label: next 5 daily OHLCV in input-window normalization; close horizon-5 converted back to return for direction
protocol.alpha_selection: 2018-2020 Friday close horizon-5 return RMSE, ties favor larger penalty
protocol.random_partition_definition: seeded permutation of each window's adaptive-normalized patch-length multiset; preserves patch count and all durations, but changes boundaries/order; not fully shape-independent
protocol.refit: annual expanding window; all training 5-day labels completed by previous year-end; P0 and scaler also fitted only on data available by cutoff
protocol.inference: 125 observed bars including Friday close; five trading-day label may overlap around holidays
protocol.execution: next observed trading-day open after Friday; positions persist until next Friday signal's next open; final liquidation at last available open
protocol.cost_interpretation: hypothetical all-in friction scenarios on a nontradable index proxy, not an ETF fill simulation or actual exchange/broker fee schedule
protocol.statistics: paired circular moving-block bootstrap, 8 weekly observations per block, 10000 replicates, fixed seed; McNemar exact as secondary descriptive test; no model chosen on test results
protocol.negative_control: shuffle normalized-adaptive training labels using fixed seed, keeping the same validation-selected penalty
protocol.replication_scope: operationalized core segmentation hypothesis, not an exact replication of the unpublished 78-index P0 / Kronos / Crossformer combination
